display_long_description:
Welcome to Lost Taggers v2!

Lost Taggers v2 is a multiplayer VR game focused on movement, fun, and fast-paced tag gameplay. Run around with other players, jump across obstacles, climb around maps, and try to avoid getting tagged while chasing others in exciting matches.

The game is built to give players a smooth and fun VR experience where you can hang out with friends, meet new people, and improve your movement skills. Every map is designed to encourage exploration and creative movement, making every match feel different.

Features:
• Multiplayer VR gameplay
• Smooth running, jumping, and climbing mechanics
• Fun and interactive maps
• Public and private lobbies
• Social gameplay with friends and other players
• Regular updates, fixes, and new content
• Easy to learn movement system

Whether you want to relax and hang out, practice your movement, or compete to become the best tagger in the lobby, Lost Taggers v2 offers a fun experience for all types of players. Step into the game, explore the maps, and enjoy the chaos of multiplayer VR tag. Because apparently running around screaming in virtual reality became a full genre now. Humanity is fascinating.
